question: Q04
reason: Correct for the literal question. All four requested subjects are resolved. Every icon requires a matching clearing-suit crafting piece; card suit does not set the cost; ordinary pieces activate once per turn; the Vagabond can reuse the pawn while exhausting one face-up undamaged hammer per icon and matching every icon with its current clearing; unavailable item supply prevents the craft; an identical effect already in the player's own play area prevents crafting another. The attached quotation explicitly gives exhaustion and flipping down, while the ruling consistently says pays one face-up undamaged hammer per icon. No repetition of exhaust in the ruling is required. The persistent-card destination is not stated, but that is a separate post-craft procedure, not an independently requested part of the specific duplicate-effects question. The complete response therefore has no material omission or wrong rule within the requested scope.
